Where customers paid since 2 Nov
Only money paid into your own account is in your balance. Payments into the company UAE account, the payment gateway, PayPal or any other company account go straight to the company. You never held that money, so it is not in your cash flow and you do not send it. It still counts in your revenue and your commission.
Paid intoOrdersAmountIn your balance? {{ c.name }}{{ c.n }}{{ c.amt }}{{ c.tag }}
No customer payments since 2 Nov.
Payment proofs (customer payments)Payments into a company account need a payment screenshot, which the company checks. Payments into your own account need no check. Every non-refunded order counts in revenue and commission whatever its proof status, and a payment marked Needs changes does not stop the work.
{{ p.k }}{{ p.n }}{{ p.amt }}
